about_the_game: Stranded in the abyss is a linear shoot 'em up in a unique sci-fi environment with an emphasis on using different ships in a squad.

short_description: Features: A system that allows you to play as an entire squad at the same time by switching ships and commanding bombers that unleash a devastating screen-clearing attack. Fast-paced combat that rewards reflexes and strategy. Combat with a unique sense of speed and style.
